Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Rolling v2.5.0 -> US=10%, EU=0%, APAC=0% (canary). Window 2024-09-10 23:00-03:00 UTC. Auto-hold at 10%.
Ravi: Starting US canary. Watch API payment route and token p95.
Jo: US warmpool healthy. p50=102ms, p95=210ms, warm nodes 40/48. No 5xx.
SRE Oncall: EU reserved GPUs 26, alloc 82%. If we ramp EU quickly, warmpool could hit 90% in ~12m during peak. Set proactive alert at 80%.
Ravi: If EU warmpool >85% during ramp we'll pin EU to v2.4.8 and throttle. Confirmed rollback trigger list?
Jo: Rollback triggers: p95 >2x baseline for >=10m, error rate >1% over 5m, GPU OOMs >=2 in 3m.
Deploy Bot: US holdpoint healthy: ok=50/50, errs=0, avgCPU=31%.
Infra-Priv Bot: APAC artifact egress: blocked until INF-512 is resolved. Ticket open.
Jo: APAC needs +6 transient GPUs to start canary; cost and infra OK but need infra-priv approval.
SRE Oncall: +1 to burst after INF-512 cleared. Monitoring thermal and eviction headroom.
Ravi: Runbook quick commands below if we must pin/rollback:
```
redwoodctl pin --region eu --version v2.4.8
redwoodctl throttle --region eu --percent 5
redwoodctl rollback --release v2.5.0 --reason "region instability"
```
Jo: EU ramp to 5% now for sanity check. Hold 12m.
Deploy Bot: EU ramp queued -> target 5%.
SRE Oncall: EU @5% (1m): p50=125ms, p95=255ms, errs=0. Warmpool +1%.
Ravi: Holding. If EU crosses 85% we execute pin->throttle. Callout here before manual action so it's logged.
Jo: ACK. I'll post the 12m readout to #release-updates.
Deploy Bot: Holdpoint reached. US/EU at 10/5. APAC pending INF-512.
